title: The Let Them Theory
author: Mel Robbins
blurb: Mel Robbins argues that much of our stress, resentment and exhaustion comes from trying to control things we never could, mainly other people. Their opinions, moods, choices and behaviour are not ours to manage. Her answer is two short phrases. The first, Let Them, means allowing people to be who they are and do what they choose, without chasing, fixing or fuming. The second, Let Me, turns the focus back to you: your response, your actions, your values. Robbins applies this simple framework to everyday struggles. These include handling stress and emotional reactions, worrying what others think, comparing yourself to others, navigating friendships that change, and supporting the people you love without trying to rescue them. The result is a practical philosophy of letting go that is not about giving up. It is about taking back your attention, time and energy for what you can actually change.
